blocks.zh: Q 8.1 — APS in RABS: Special Considerations Q 8.1 — RABS 中無菌製程模擬（APS）的特殊考量
blocks.en: Q 8.1 - APS in RABS: Special Considerations

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Aseptic Process Simulation, APS (無菌製程模擬)：以培養基取代實際藥品，模擬整個無菌充填過程，驗證系統在正常與最差條件下，能否維持無菌保證 (Sterility Assurance)。APS 本質上是對「整個無菌製造系統」的一次綜合性能力測試。
blocks.en: Aseptic Process Simulation (APS): Replaces the actual drug product with growth medium to simulate the entire aseptic filling process, verifying that the system can maintain sterility assurance under both normal and worst-case conditions. In essence, an APS is a comprehensive capability test of the whole aseptic manufacturing system.

blocks.zh: Risk-Based Analysis (基於風險的分析)：APS 的設計不是隨意的，而是以品質風險管理 (QRM) 為驅動。需先識別哪些步驟具有最高的污染風險，再據此設計模擬方案。這也呼應了 EU Annex 1 對 Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) 的核心要求。
blocks.en: Risk-Based Analysis: The APS design is not arbitrary; it is driven by quality risk management (QRM). The steps with the highest contamination risk are identified first, and the simulation program is designed accordingly. This also echoes the core requirement of EU Annex 1 for a Contamination Control Strategy (CCS).

blocks.zh: Piggyback APS (搭便車式 APS)：在常規生產批次結束後，緊接著執行一次 APS。優點是可驗證延長生產時間或 campaign 長度的能力。但其重大限制在於：它無法模擬 setup 階段的活動（因為 setup 只發生在 campaign 的第一批），所以不能單獨使用，必須搭配傳統 APS 一起構成完整的驗證方案。
blocks.en: Piggyback APS: An APS performed immediately after a routine production batch. Its advantage is that it can verify the ability to support extended production time or campaign length. Its major limitation is that it cannot simulate setup activities (because setup occurs only at the start of a campaign), so it cannot be used alone and must be combined with a traditional APS to form a complete validation program.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你是一位飛行員，APS 就像是飛行模擬器測試。你必須在模擬器中重現所有可能遇到的情境：正常起降、惡劣天氣、引擎故障等。RABS 的 APS 也是如此 -- 你不僅要模擬正常充填，還要模擬 open-door intervention（相當於緊急降落程序）、setup（相當於起飛前檢查），以及所有可能的worst-case 情境。
blocks.en: Imagine you are a pilot and the APS is a flight simulator test. In the simulator you must reproduce every situation you might meet: normal takeoff and landing, bad weather, engine failure and so on. The same is true of a RABS APS: you must simulate not only normal filling but also open-door interventions (the equivalent of emergency landing procedures), setup (the equivalent of pre-flight checks) and every possible worst-case scenario.

blocks.zh: 而 Piggyback APS 就像是在一次正常飛行結束後，順便進行額外的模擬測試 -- 你可以測試「長時間飛行」的耐力，但你無法從中驗證「起飛前完整檢查程序」是否正確，因為你已經飛在空中了。
blocks.en: A piggyback APS is like running extra simulator tests after a normal flight has ended. You can test the endurance of a "long flight", but you cannot verify that the "complete pre-flight check procedure" is correct, because you are already in the air.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: APS 的六大先決條件：在執行 APS 之前，以下所有項目都必須已完成確效/確認：
blocks.en: Six prerequisites for an APS: Before an APS is performed, all of the following must already be validated/qualified:

blocks.zh: 潔淨室確效 -- UDAF 設備符合環境要求
blocks.en: Cleanroom qualification - the UDAF equipment meets the environmental requirements

blocks.zh: RABS 確效 -- HEPA 完整性、壓差、風速、AVS 全部合格
blocks.en: RABS qualification - HEPA integrity, differential pressure, air velocity and AVS all pass

blocks.zh: 人員訓練 -- Grade A/B 無菌更衣與無菌行為訓練完成
blocks.en: Personnel training - Grade A/B aseptic gowning and aseptic behavior training completed

blocks.zh: 介入清單 -- 固有/矯正介入已定義並納入 CCS
blocks.en: Intervention list - inherent/corrective interventions defined and incorporated into the CCS

blocks.zh: 物料傳遞方法 -- 已確效且不會危及 Grade A 環境
blocks.en: Material transfer methods - validated and not compromising the Grade A environment

blocks.zh: EM 計畫 -- 基於風險評估建立完整的環境監控方案
blocks.en: EM program - a complete environmental monitoring program established on the basis of risk assessment

blocks.zh: 特別注意原文的警語："APS cannot be used to justify poor design of equipment and processes." -- APS 是用來驗證良好設計的有效性，而不是用來為不良設計找藉口。
blocks.en: Note the warning in the source text: "APS cannot be used to justify poor design of equipment and processes." The APS verifies the effectiveness of a good design; it is not a way to excuse a poor one.

blocks.zh: 法規連結 Regulatory Link
blocks.en: Regulatory Link

blocks.zh: 本節參考了 PDA TR No. 22 (Revised 2011)：Process Simulation for Aseptically Filled Products，這是 APS 設計的核心指引文件。此外，EU Annex 1 (2022) 第 9 章對 APS 有詳細要求，包括最少充填量、頻率、以及對 worst-case 條件的模擬要求。
blocks.en: This section refers to PDA TR No. 22 (Revised 2011): Process Simulation for Aseptically Filled Products, the core guidance document for APS design. In addition, Chapter 9 of EU Annex 1 (2022) sets out detailed APS requirements, including minimum fill volume, frequency, and the requirement to simulate worst-case conditions.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 假設你是一家 CDMO 的驗證主管，客戶要求使用 RABS 充填線進行 3 天 campaign 生產。你的 APS 方案設計必須考慮：
blocks.en: Suppose you are the validation manager at a CDMO, and a customer asks for a 3-day campaign on a RABS filling line. Your APS program design must consider:

blocks.zh: 傳統 APS 至少一次，涵蓋完整 setup 與 closed-door intervention 模擬
blocks.en: At least one traditional APS, covering the full setup and simulation of closed-door interventions

blocks.zh: 可考慮增加 Piggyback APS，在實際生產結束後接續執行，以驗證延長生產時間的能力
blocks.en: Consider adding a piggyback APS, run after actual production ends, to verify the ability to support extended production time

blocks.zh: 兩種 APS 的搭配使用需有正式的風險評估文件支持
blocks.en: The combined use of the two types of APS must be supported by a formal risk assessment document

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 RABS 比 Isolator 更需要關注 open-door intervention 的 APS 模擬？
blocks.en: Why does a RABS need more attention to open-door intervention simulation in the APS than an isolator does?

blocks.zh: 如果一家公司只執行 Piggyback APS 而沒有傳統 APS，在稽核時可能會被提出什麼缺失？
blocks.en: If a company performs only a piggyback APS and no traditional APS, what deficiency might be raised during an audit?

blocks.zh: AVS 為什麼被列為 APS 的先決條件之一？試從氣流與污染控制的角度說明。
blocks.en: Why is AVS listed as one of the prerequisites for the APS? Explain from the perspective of airflow and contamination control.

blocks.zh: Q 8.2 — APS for Multiple Shifts and Campaign Production Q 8.2 — 多班次與連續生產的無菌製程模擬（APS）
blocks.en: Q 8.2 - APS for Multiple Shifts and Campaign Production

blocks.zh: Campaign Manufacturing (連續生產/戰役式生產)：指在不進行完整清潔和重新 setup 的情況下，連續生產多個批次的模式。在 RABS 中，這意味著某些零件（如間接接觸產品的零件）在整個 campaign 期間保持安裝狀態。
blocks.en: Campaign Manufacturing: A mode in which multiple batches are produced consecutively without full cleaning and re-setup. In a RABS, this means that some parts (such as parts with indirect product contact) remain installed throughout the campaign.

blocks.zh: "Events Rather Than Time" (事件而非時間)：這是本節最重要的觀念 -- 污染主要是由「事件」（如介入、物料傳遞、人員操作）造成的，而不是單純因為「時間長」就會污染。因此，APS 的時長不需要等於或超過最長生產時間，關鍵是要充分模擬所有可能引入污染的「事件」。
blocks.en: "Events Rather Than Time": This is the most important idea in this section. Contamination is primarily an outcome of "events" (such as interventions, material transfers and personnel activities), not simply of a long duration. The APS duration therefore does not need to equal or exceed the longest production time; the key is to adequately simulate all the "events" that could introduce contamination.

blocks.zh: Direct (直接接觸產品零件)：如充填針頭 -- 在 campaign 中可能需要更換，APS 應模擬這種更換操作
blocks.en: Direct (direct product contact parts): Such as filling needles - these may need to be changed during a campaign, and the APS should simulate the change

blocks.zh: Indirect (間接接觸產品零件)：如導軌、stopper bowl -- 在整個 campaign 期間保持安裝，受 aseptic hold time 限制
blocks.en: Indirect (indirect product contact parts): Such as guide rails and the stopper bowl - these remain installed throughout the campaign and are subject to the aseptic hold time limit

blocks.zh: Campaign 生產的 APS 設計，就像規劃一次長途公路旅行的安全測試。你不需要實際開完全程 3,000 公里才能證明車子安全，但你需要模擬旅途中所有關鍵事件：加油停靠（相當於 batch 間的操作）、換輪胎（相當於更換充填針頭）、長時間駕駛後的疲勞管理（相當於操作員輪班和休息安排）。重點不是開了多少公里，而是有沒有把所有可能出問題的「事件」都測試到。
blocks.en: Designing an APS for campaign production is like planning a safety test for a long road trip. You do not need to drive the full 3,000 km to prove the car is safe, but you do need to simulate all the key events on the journey: refueling stops (the equivalent of operations between batches), changing a tire (the equivalent of changing filling needles), and managing fatigue after long driving (the equivalent of operator shift and break arrangements). What matters is not how many kilometers you drive, but whether you have tested every "event" that could go wrong.

blocks.zh: Campaign APS 的必模擬項目清單：
blocks.en: Checklist of items a campaign APS must simulate:

blocks.zh: Setup 階段 -- 包含初始 open-door 活動
blocks.en: Setup phase - including the initial open-door activities

blocks.zh: 介入操作 -- 類型、頻率、時長均須代表性
blocks.en: Interventions - type, frequency and duration must all be representative

blocks.zh: 間接接觸零件 -- 模擬完整 campaign 期間的安裝狀態與 hold time
blocks.en: Indirect contact parts - simulate the installed state and hold time over the full campaign period

blocks.zh: 直接接觸零件 -- 模擬是否更換或保留（如充填針頭）
blocks.en: Direct contact parts - simulate whether they are changed or retained (such as filling needles)

blocks.zh: RABS 手套 -- 整個 campaign 期間保持安裝
blocks.en: RABS gloves - remain installed throughout the campaign

blocks.zh: 清潔/消毒 -- 模擬批次間的常規清潔消毒操作
blocks.en: Cleaning/disinfection - simulate routine cleaning and disinfection between batches

blocks.zh: 生產暫停/中斷 -- 模擬計畫性或非計畫性停頓
blocks.en: Production pauses/interruptions - simulate planned or unplanned stoppages

blocks.zh: 無菌取樣 -- 重大介入後的取樣程序
blocks.en: Aseptic sampling - the sampling procedure after major interventions

blocks.zh: 常見誤區 Common Misconception
blocks.en: Common Misconception

blocks.zh: 許多公司誤以為 APS 必須跑得和實際生產一樣長。原文明確指出：「there is no requirement that the APS should be equal to or longer than the maximum production duration」。APS 的目的是驗證「事件管控能力」，而非「時間耐受力」。時間相關的控制（如環境維持、手套完整性、人員疲勞）應由其他工具（如 EM、設備確效、人因評估）來保障。
blocks.en: Many companies mistakenly believe that the APS must run as long as actual production. The source text states explicitly: "there is no requirement that the APS should be equal to or longer than the maximum production duration". The purpose of the APS is to verify "control of events", not "endurance over time". Time-related controls (such as environmental maintenance, glove integrity and operator fatigue) should be assured by other tools (such as EM, equipment qualification and human factors assessment).

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 的 RABS 充填線進行 5 天 campaign（每天 2 班），共生產 10 個批次。APS 設計考量：
blocks.en: A CDMO's RABS filling line runs a 5-day campaign (2 shifts per day), producing 10 batches in total. APS design considerations:

blocks.zh: APS 時長不需要 5 天，但需模擬所有關鍵事件
blocks.en: The APS does not need to last 5 days, but it must simulate all critical events

blocks.zh: 包含完整 setup + 至少模擬「批次間」的清潔消毒轉換
blocks.en: Include the full setup plus at least a simulation of the cleaning and disinfection changeover "between batches"

blocks.zh: 充填針頭若每 2 天更換一次，APS 需包含此更換操作
blocks.en: If filling needles are changed every 2 days, the APS must include this change

blocks.zh: 模擬操作員輪班交接的程序
blocks.en: Simulate the operator shift handover procedure

blocks.zh: 在適當時機取 sterility sample（如重大介入後）
blocks.en: Take a sterility sample at appropriate points (such as after major interventions)

blocks.zh: 原文說「contamination is primarily an outcome of events rather than time」，這句話對你設計 APS 時長有什麼啟示？
blocks.en: The source text says "contamination is primarily an outcome of events rather than time". What does this tell you about designing the APS duration?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Piggyback APS 在 campaign 模式下「不被視為最佳實務」？它具體缺少了什麼？
blocks.en: Why is a piggyback APS "not considered best practice" in campaign mode? What exactly does it lack?

blocks.zh: 如果 campaign 期間 RABS 手套破損需更換，這個事件應該如何在 APS 中處理？
blocks.en: If a RABS glove tears and has to be replaced during a campaign, how should this event be handled in the APS?

blocks.zh: Q 8.3 — Worst-Case Conditions in RABS APS Q 8.3 — RABS 無菌製程模擬（APS）中的最差狀況條件
blocks.en: Q 8.3 - Worst-Case Conditions in RABS APS

blocks.zh: 定義 worst-case 就像消防演習的情境設計。你會模擬「最困難但合理的逃生情境」，例如：電梯故障、某條走廊被煙霧阻擋。但你不會模擬「整棟大樓瞬間倒塌」，因為那超出了合理預期的範圍。
blocks.en: Defining worst case is like designing the scenario for a fire drill. You simulate the "most difficult but reasonable escape situation", for example a broken elevator or a corridor blocked by smoke. But you do not simulate "the whole building collapsing instantly", because that is beyond reasonable expectation.

blocks.zh: 同樣地，RABS APS 的 worst-case 應該模擬「open-door intervention」（最高風險事件），但不應該人為創造一個不可能在正常操作中出現的極端條件（例如同時打開所有門並關閉所有氣流）。
blocks.en: Likewise, the worst case in a RABS APS should simulate an "open-door intervention" (the highest-risk event), but should not artificially create an extreme condition that could never occur in normal operation (for example, opening all doors and shutting off all airflow at the same time).

blocks.zh: RABS 獨特優勢 -- 某些傳統 worst-case 參數影響較低：
blocks.en: A unique advantage of RABS - some traditional worst-case parameters have less impact:

blocks.zh: 與傳統開放式無菌充填不同，RABS 的物理屏障將產品/關鍵表面與操作員和低等級環境隔開。因此，以下參數在 RABS 中的影響顯著降低：
blocks.en: Unlike conventional open aseptic filling, the physical barrier of a RABS separates the product/critical surfaces from operators and the lower-grade environment. As a result, the impact of the following parameters is markedly reduced in a RABS:

blocks.zh: Hold time (保留時間) -- 滅菌物料在屏障內受保護
blocks.en: Hold time - sterilized materials are protected inside the barrier

blocks.zh: 充填時長 -- 屏障關閉時環境控制穩定
blocks.en: Filling duration - environmental control is stable while the barrier is closed

blocks.zh: 人員數量 -- 操作員在屏障外，不直接暴露產品
blocks.en: Number of personnel - operators are outside the barrier and not directly exposed to the product

blocks.zh: 充填速度 -- 雖仍需考慮（最慢/最快），但影響較傳統系統低
blocks.en: Filling speed - still to be considered (slowest/fastest), but with less impact than in conventional systems

blocks.zh: 這是 RABS 相較於傳統無菌充填的一個重要風險降低優勢，也是選擇 RABS 技術的商業價值所在。
blocks.en: This is an important risk-reduction advantage of a RABS over conventional aseptic filling, and it is the commercial value of choosing RABS technology.

blocks.zh: 兩句警語 Two Warnings
blocks.en: Two Warnings

blocks.zh: 原文重複強調了兩個關鍵原則：
blocks.en: The source text repeatedly emphasizes two key principles:

blocks.zh: "APS is not used to validate bad practices" -- APS 不是為不良操作背書的工具
blocks.en: "APS is not used to validate bad practices" - the APS is not a tool for endorsing poor practice

blocks.zh: "Worst-case does not mean creation of artificial conditions...that can force a system failure" -- worst-case 不等於人為製造系統崩潰
blocks.en: "Worst-case does not mean creation of artificial conditions...that can force a system failure" - worst case does not mean deliberately causing the system to collapse

blocks.zh: 這兩句話為 APS 設計劃定了明確的邊界：APS 驗證的是「在合理操作範圍內，系統能否維持無菌保證」。
blocks.en: These two statements set clear boundaries for APS design: the APS verifies whether, "within a reasonable operating range, the system can maintain sterility assurance".

blocks.zh: 為什麼 open-door intervention 是 RABS APS 中「最高風險」的 worst-case 條件？試從屏障完整性的角度解釋。
blocks.en: Why is open-door intervention the "highest-risk" worst-case condition in a RABS APS? Explain from the perspective of barrier integrity.

blocks.zh: 某公司在 APS 設計中同時模擬「最慢充填速度 + 最多人員 + 最長 hold time」。根據本節內容，這種設計是否合理？為什麼？
blocks.en: A company simulates "slowest filling speed + maximum number of personnel + longest hold time" together in its APS design. Based on this section, is this design reasonable? Why?

blocks.zh: 「APS is not used to validate bad practices」這句話在實務上如何應用？請舉一個具體例子。
blocks.en: How is "APS is not used to validate bad practices" applied in practice? Give a specific example.

blocks.zh: Worst-Case Conditions (最差條件)：在 APS 中模擬的「最具挑戰性」的操作條件。但有一個非常重要的界限：worst-case 必須在允許的操作範圍內，不能人為創造超出正常操作邊界的條件來強制系統失敗。
blocks.en: Worst-Case Conditions: The "most challenging" operating conditions simulated in the APS. There is one very important limit: the worst case must lie within the permitted operating range, and conditions beyond normal operating boundaries must not be artificially created to force the system to fail.

blocks.zh: RABS 的 Worst-Case 分層：
blocks.en: Tiers of RABS worst case:

blocks.zh: Q 8.4 — Setup and Assembly Best Practices Q 8.4 — 設備設置與組裝最佳實務
blocks.en: Q 8.4 - Setup and Assembly Best Practices

blocks.zh: RABS 的 setup 就像手術室的術前準備：
blocks.en: RABS setup is like pre-operative preparation in an operating room:

blocks.zh: Phase 1 (門開啟) = 將滅菌器械從運送車搬入手術室。此時手術室門開著，風險最高，必須快速且有紀律地完成。護理人員的位置不能阻擋層流氣流。
blocks.en: Phase 1 (door open) = moving sterilized instruments from the transport cart into the operating room. The room door is open and the risk is highest, so the work must be done quickly and with discipline. Nurses must not stand where they block the laminar airflow.

blocks.zh: Phase 2 (門關閉) = 手術室門關閉後，進行器械的精細擺放與最終確認。此時環境受控，但仍需穿戴無菌手套操作。
blocks.en: Phase 2 (door closed) = once the operating room door is closed, the instruments are carefully arranged and finally checked. The environment is now controlled, but sterile gloves are still required for the work.

blocks.zh: First Air = 就像手術室天花板的層流罩，潔淨空氣必須從上方往下流過器械台，再向外排出，操作人員不能站在氣流的「上游」。
blocks.en: First Air = like the laminar flow hood on the operating room ceiling: clean air must flow from above, down over the instrument table and then out, and personnel must not stand "upstream" of the airflow.

blocks.zh: Open-Door Setup 的最佳實務檢查清單：
blocks.en: Best-practice checklist for open-door setup:

blocks.zh: 操作員定位 -- 保護性氣流經過手/袖後流向潔淨室（不可阻擋 First Air）
blocks.en: Operator positioning - protective airflow passes over the hands/sleeves and then flows to the cleanroom (First Air must not be blocked)

blocks.zh: 物料擺放 -- 待傳遞物料放在工作高度的推車上
blocks.en: Material placement - materials to be transferred are placed on a cart at working height

blocks.zh: 副操作員 -- 可協助定位，但不得影響保護性氣流
blocks.en: Secondary operator - may assist with positioning but must not disturb the protective airflow

blocks.zh: 無菌技術 -- 使用雙袋法傳遞；操作範圍限於必要任務
blocks.en: Aseptic technique - use the double-bag method for transfer; limit actions to necessary tasks

blocks.zh: 手部消毒 -- 開門介入前，依合格程序進行手部消毒（參考 PDA TR-62）
blocks.en: Hand disinfection - before an open-door intervention, disinfect hands according to a qualified procedure (see PDA TR-62)

blocks.zh: 持續 EM -- 介入期間鄰近位置持續進行環境監控（viable + nonviable）
blocks.en: Continuous EM - continuous environmental monitoring (viable + nonviable) at adjacent locations during the intervention

blocks.zh: 手套安裝 -- 開門 setup 的最後步驟才安裝滅菌 RABS 手套
blocks.en: Glove installation - sterilized RABS gloves are installed as the last step of the open-door setup

blocks.zh: 門內側消毒 -- 關門前/關門時對門內側進行消毒
blocks.en: Door interior disinfection - disinfect the inside of the door before/while closing it

blocks.zh: 設計原則 Design Principle
blocks.en: Design Principle

blocks.zh: 原文強調：「As much as possible, set-up should be performed with the doors closed」。這意味著 RABS 的設備設計應盡量讓操作人員能透過手套口或 RTP 完成大部分 setup 工作，將必須開門的操作降到最低。這是設備採購規格（URS）中應明確要求的設計理念。
blocks.en: The source text stresses: "As much as possible, set-up should be performed with the doors closed". This means the RABS design should let operators complete most of the setup through the glove ports or RTPs, minimizing operations that require opening the door. This design philosophy should be stated explicitly in the equipment purchase specification (URS).

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，選購 RABS 設備時，應評估「多少 setup 操作可在關門狀態下完成」作為重要的設備評選標準。能在關門狀態下完成更多 setup 的設備，代表更低的污染風險和更高的無菌保證水準。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, when purchasing a RABS, "how much of the setup can be done with the doors closed" should be an important selection criterion. Equipment that allows more setup with the doors closed means lower contamination risk and a higher level of sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 你正在為一條新的 RABS 充填線撰寫 Setup SOP，以下是需要定義的關鍵項目：
blocks.en: You are writing the setup SOP for a new RABS filling line. The key items to define are:

blocks.zh: 開門操作清單：列出所有必須在開門狀態下完成的操作，並為每一項定義最大允許時間
blocks.en: Open-door operations list: list all operations that must be done with the door open, and define the maximum allowed time for each

blocks.zh: 操作員站位圖：標示主操作員與副操作員的位置，確保不阻擋保護性氣流方向
blocks.en: Operator position diagram: mark the positions of the primary and secondary operators, ensuring they do not block the direction of the protective airflow

blocks.zh: EM 取樣點：在開門介入區域周邊設置連續監控點
blocks.en: EM sampling points: place continuous monitoring points around the open-door intervention area

blocks.zh: 關門檢查表：門內側消毒完成、手套安裝確認、完整 EM 啟動
blocks.en: Door-closing checklist: door interior disinfection completed, glove installation confirmed, full EM started

blocks.zh: AVS 結果參考：附上 AVS 確效報告中的氣流方向示意圖，作為操作員訓練教材
blocks.en: AVS reference: attach the airflow direction diagrams from the AVS qualification report as operator training material

blocks.zh: 為什麼 RABS 手套的安裝是 open-door setup 的「最後步驟」？如果先安裝手套再傳入其他物料，會有什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why is the installation of RABS gloves the "last step" of open-door setup? What problems arise if gloves are installed first and other materials are transferred in afterwards?

blocks.zh: 原文提到 AVS 應展示「RABS 內部到周圍區域的適當氣流」。在 open-door setup 時，理想的氣流方向應該是什麼？為什麼？
blocks.en: The source text says the AVS should demonstrate "appropriate airflow from inside the RABS to the surrounding area". What should the ideal airflow direction be during open-door setup, and why?

blocks.zh: 如果你是設備供應商，你會如何設計 RABS 來最大化「關門狀態下可完成的 setup 操作」比例？
blocks.en: If you were an equipment supplier, how would you design a RABS to maximize the proportion of setup operations that can be completed with the doors closed?

blocks.zh: Two Setup Conditions (兩階段 Setup)：RABS 的 setup 分為兩個截然不同的階段，風險等級完全不同：
blocks.en: Two Setup Conditions: RABS setup has two distinct phases with completely different risk levels:

blocks.zh: First Air (第一氣流)：指從 HEPA 過濾器出來後，尚未接觸任何物體或人員的潔淨氣流。在 open-door setup 時，操作員必須確保 First Air 從 RABS 內部流向外部，經過操作員的手和袖子後排出。這是防止外部污染進入 Grade A 區域的第一道防線。
blocks.en: First Air: Clean air that has left the HEPA filter and has not yet contacted any object or person. During open-door setup, operators must ensure First Air flows from inside the RABS outward, passing over the operator's hands and sleeves before leaving. This is the first line of defense against external contamination entering the Grade A area.

blocks.zh: Double-Bag Method (雙袋法)：將滅菌物品的外層包裝在 RABS 介面處移除，僅將內層（無菌）包裝傳入 Grade A 區域的技術。這是維持無菌傳遞的標準做法。
blocks.en: Double-Bag Method: A technique in which the outer packaging of a sterilized item is removed at the RABS interface and only the inner (sterile) packaging is passed into the Grade A area. This is the standard practice for maintaining aseptic transfer.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: APS 先決條件：潔淨室確效、RABS 確效（HEPA/壓差/AVS）、人員訓練、介入清單、物料傳遞方法、EM 計畫 -- 六項缺一不可
blocks.en: APS prerequisites: Cleanroom qualification, RABS qualification (HEPA/differential pressure/AVS), personnel training, intervention list, material transfer methods and EM program - all six are indispensable

blocks.zh: 事件驅動原則：污染是「事件」的結果而非「時間」的結果 -- APS 時長不需等於最長生產時間，關鍵是模擬所有可能引入污染的事件
blocks.en: Event-driven principle: Contamination is the result of "events", not of "time" - the APS duration need not equal the longest production time; the key is to simulate all events that could introduce contamination

blocks.zh: Worst-Case 邊界：最差條件必須在合理操作範圍內；APS 不能用來驗證不良設計或操作實務
blocks.en: Worst-case boundary: Worst-case conditions must lie within a reasonable operating range; the APS cannot be used to validate poor design or poor operating practices

blocks.zh: RABS 獨特優勢：因物理屏障的存在，hold time、充填時長、人員數量、充填速度等傳統 worst-case 參數對 RABS 的影響較低
blocks.en: Unique RABS advantage: Because of the physical barrier, traditional worst-case parameters such as hold time, filling duration, number of personnel and filling speed have less impact on a RABS

blocks.zh: Open-Door 最高風險：open-door intervention（包含 setup）是 RABS 中風險最高的操作，應是 APS worst-case 設計的焦點
blocks.en: Open-door is the highest risk: Open-door interventions (including setup) are the highest-risk operations in a RABS and should be the focus of APS worst-case design

blocks.zh: 兩階段 Setup：開門階段（最高風險）與關門階段（受控環境）的操作要求截然不同，設備設計應盡量讓 setup 在關門狀態下完成
blocks.en: Two-phase setup: The open-door phase (highest risk) and the closed-door phase (controlled environment) have very different operating requirements; equipment design should allow as much setup as possible to be completed with the doors closed

blocks.zh: Piggyback APS 的限制：可作為整體 APS 方案的補充，但不能單獨使用，因為它無法模擬 setup 階段
blocks.en: Limitation of piggyback APS: It can supplement the overall APS program but cannot be used alone, because it cannot simulate the setup phase
